QuestInfo.0: Someone wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Someone wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.2: ...SHE's Spiegelmann's little sister? Wow... Head on over to the #b#eMonster Park#n#k and try out Monster Park Extreme.

0.0: Hey there, good lookin'! The name's #b#p9071006##k and that brill-creme scented walrus over there is my brother.
0.1: I'm going to tell you about an opportunity so rich you'd have to be a regular million-meso-miser to pass it up. My brother and I call it #b#eMonster Park Extreme#n#k! It's positively monstrous, extremely.
0.2: It's a good old-fashioned romp so fun you'll be howling at the moon, and not just because you got bit by a werewolf!

yes.0: Come on down to the Monster Park and have a little fun, why don't ya?

no.0: You don't believe me? Why, if I'm not right about you, I'll take off my little hat!
